ordinary_post_development_review: Reviewed the local domain counterexample and full positive Schur principal symbol. Each derivative may be extended by an auxiliary cutoff equal to one on the bolt test disk and zero near the outer boundary; the local pairings and failure are unchanged, so no outer condition is altered. The actual smooth radial measure is c rho(1+O(rho^2)); its corrections are lower order in the packet ratio. For the areal derivative a=1/(2rho), the coefficient -a prime is positive and the highest-log commutator has relative coefficient 2/rho^2. On annuli d=k^(-3/4), k*d tends to infinity; polar errors are relatively small. Local finite fourth contacts are lower logarithmic order; B is order zero; actual distant inverse returns are smooth and remain in the operator. The weighted average 2/t^2 lies between 1/2 and 2. This proves an infinite constant only for the proposed bounded stationary energy commutator, not for stronger-input or localized Cartesian estimates. The conormal scaling test rules out the proposed areal comparison from conormal energy jets alone. A tame areal commutator requires at least two extra disk derivatives, with no sufficiency claim at the endpoint. The Cartesian route requires a local jet-system argument, not a stationary global inverse acting on nonstationary derivatives. Twelve form-commutator orders and all numerical output/input comparisons remain unproved. All physical solution gates remain open.
